remarks: Welcome to 26 Four Winds Way. One of only twelve homes on a private road, this 2011 built home has everything you are looking for. A recently completed custom renovation makes this property truly exceptional. Featuring a chef’s kitchen where no detail was overlooked. Wood mode cabinetry, Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, an 8-person island with a waterfall marble countertop and direct access to the pool and covered patio, this is an entertainer’s dream. The kitchen opens to the two story, sunken family room with fireplace and adjacent private office. The wine bar leads into the dining area, two-story foyer with French wood door main entrance and a half bath. The back hall is home to the laundry room, pantry and garage entrance and a second front entrance. The primary suite is breathtaking. With trayed ceilings, huge bathroom and two walk-in closets, this space feels like a luxury hotel. Two other bedrooms, both with walk-in closets, share a jack and jill bathroom and the final bedroom has an en-suite bath and walk-in closet. The basement is partially finished and perfect for added entrainment space. The backyard is a true oasis with professional landscaping and a heated Gunite saltwater pool. A brand-new custom pool house boasts sliding glass doors leading to a sitting area with fireplace, half bath and kitchenette with a built-in ice maker, refrigerator and sink. The heated and cooled three car garage has ceilings high enough for a golf simulator. Additional features include a generator, tankless hot water heater and custom light fixtures through the home.  Showings begin Friday, 10/9 at 10am.
